post.description: Generates a public / private key pair and wraps it in a certificate self signed for ten years (subject `CN=keypair-<serial>`), flagged as a key pair (`keypair: true`) and named `KeyPair - <serial>`, the way otoroshi stores key pairs (to sign and verify jwt tokens for instance). The generated certificate is answered as a certificate entity, with its chain and its private key, and stored unless `persist=false`. Only a super admin can call it. The self signed certificate is always signed with `SHA256WithRSAEncryption`: only an rsa key pair can be generated here, any other algorithm being answered as a bad request.
